abstract_requirement.attribute: 颜色识别 (黑、白、灰、红、蓝、黄、绿、紫、迷彩)
constraints: 目标对象：口罩，部件/场景：位置/颜色/图案，属性/缺陷：特定颜色识别，任务类型：颜色分类。
行业术语同义词：3D mask,急诊口罩，防疫口罩，P3/N95 mask,医用口罩，色调/颜色/类别，five colors,多色，camouflage/camo/迷彩

现有模型/算法：Color classification,色分类，Pan-classification,palette analysis/调色盘分析,color-based segmentation/基于色的分割，polychromatic detection/多彩检测，multi-class classification/多类分类，K-based detection，YOLO-ColorNet,Lab plot/色度图分析
性能与基准：mAP/mIoU,accuracy,precision/recall,F1 score,mean PAE/FPD,valid@N,kappa系数,confusion matrix/C矩阵,ROC/AUC,Hybrid score

数据与标注：color specific imagery/特定色图像，labeling guidelines，color calibration/颜色校正，multi-scale/anymulti-shot/多尺度，transformer/attention-based/注意力机制，pose estimation/姿态估计，ROI extraction/感兴趣区域提取，color histogram/直方图/色值，color thresholding/阈值分割
